title: A 4AP-free permutation of the positive integers
abstract: Formalizes Boon Suan Ho's construction of a permutation of the positive integers with no four-term arithmetic progression as a subsequence, proving the binary-order lemmas, extension lemma, and computable limit.

informal.FourAP.exists_fourAPFree_positive_permut: There exists a bijection of the positive integers such that no four increasing positions map to a nonconstant four-term arithmetic progression, including negative common differences.
informal.FourAP.explicitPositivePermutation_apFre: The explicit computable positive-integer permutation constructed in the development has the stated four-term progression avoidance property.
